sections.Profile:
"Ace High," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1957, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
